hero.label: About Simphonia
hero.desc: We believe staying connected while traveling should be effortless, affordable, and available to everyone.

story.label: Our Story
story.quote: "I landed in Tokyo at midnight with zero mobile data. No maps, no ride, no translation. That one trip changed everything."
story.p1: That frustration — the overpriced roaming, the hunt for local SIM cards, the confusing carrier shops — became the spark behind Simphonia.
story.p2: Founded in 2024, we set out to make global connectivity instant and accessible for every traveler. Today, Simphonia covers 200+ countries with one-tap eSIM activation, transparent pricing, and 24/7 AI-powered support.

values.label: Our Values
values.heading: What Drives Us
values.v1Desc: We think globally. Every feature, every plan, every decision is made with the world traveler in mind. Coverage without borders.
values.v2Desc: Speed matters when you travel. From purchase to activation, everything happens in seconds. No waiting, no delays.
values.v3Desc: No hidden fees, no surprise charges, no fine print. What you see is what you pay. We believe trust is built through honesty.
values.v4Desc: Every feature exists because a traveler needed it. We listen, iterate, and ship relentlessly to solve real travel pain points.

cta.heading: Be Part of the Journey
cta.desc: Explore our destinations and stay connected wherever you travel.

hero.label: How It Works
hero.desc: No stores to visit, no SIM cards to swap, no contracts to sign. Just seamless global connectivity in three steps.

steps.label: The Process
steps.heading: Three Steps to Connected
steps.desc: No store visits, no waiting, no physical SIM swap required.
steps.step1Desc: Open Simphonia and browse 200+ countries. Compare plans by data, duration, and price — or let smart filters find the perfect match for your trip.
steps.step2Desc: Checkout in under 30 seconds with Apple Pay, Google Pay, or any major card. Your eSIM QR code is generated instantly — no email, no shipping, no delays.
steps.step3Desc: Scan the QR code in your phone settings before departure. Your eSIM activates automatically when you land — keep your number, drop the roaming fees.

content.intro: At Simphonia (“we”, “us”, “our”), we are committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our mobile application and website (collectively, the “Service”).
content.s1_1Intro: When you create an account or make a purchase, we may collect:
content.s1_1Item2: Payment information (processed securely by our payment provider)
content.s1_1Item3: Device information (model, operating system, eSIM compatibility)
content.s1_2Intro: We automatically collect certain information when you use the Service:
content.s1_2Item1: App usage patterns and feature interactions
content.s1_2Item4: General location data (country/region level, not precise GPS)
content.s1_3Text: When you contact our support team or use the AI chat feature, we collect the content of your messages to provide assistance and improve our service.
content.s2Intro: We use the collected information for the following purposes:
content.s2Item1: To provide, maintain, and improve the Service
content.s2Item2: To process transactions and deliver eSIM profiles
content.s2Item3: To send transactional communications (order confirmations, receipts)
content.s2Item4: To provide customer support and respond to inquiries
content.s2Item5: To detect, prevent, and address technical issues and fraud
content.s2Item6: To analyze usage trends and improve user experience
content.s3Intro: We do not sell your personal information. We may share data with:
content.s3Item1: eSIM providers: To activate and manage your eSIM profiles
content.s3Item3: Analytics services: To understand app usage (anonymized data)
content.s3Item4: Legal authorities: When required by law or to protect our rights
content.s4Text: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your information, including encryption in transit (TLS) and at rest, secure authentication mechanisms, and regular security audits.
content.s5Text: We retain your personal information for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide services. You may request deletion of your account and associated data at any time by contacting us.
content.s6Intro: Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have the right to:
content.s6Item1: Access the personal data we hold about you
content.s6Item4: Object to or restrict processing of your data
content.s7Text: Our website uses minimal, essential cookies for functionality. We do not use third-party advertising cookies. Analytics cookies are only used with your consent where required by law.
content.s8Text: Our Service is not directed to children under 16. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.
content.s9Text: Your information may be transferred to and processed in countries outside your country of residence. We ensure appropriate safeguards are in place in accordance with applicable data protection laws.
content.s10Text: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any material changes by posting the updated policy on this page and updating the “Last updated” date.
content.s11Text: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or wish to exercise your rights, contact us at:

cta.heading: Have a question about your data?
cta.desc: Our support team is happy to help with any privacy-related inquiries.

content.s1Text: By creating an account, making a purchase, or otherwise using the Service, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agree to be bound by these Terms and our Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, do not use the Service.

content.s2Item4: Customer support via AI chat and human agents

content.s4_1Text: All prices are displayed in the currency shown at the time of purchase. Prices may vary based on destination, data amount, and validity period.
content.s4_2Text: Payments are processed through secure third-party payment providers. We do not store your full payment card details on our servers.
content.s4_3Intro: Refunds are available under the following conditions:
content.s4_3Item1: Unused eSIM: Full refund within 30 days of purchase if the eSIM has not been activated
content.s4_3Item2: Technical issues: If we are unable to deliver a working eSIM profile, you are entitled to a full refund or replacement
content.s4_3Item3: Used eSIM: Once data has been consumed, refunds are evaluated on a case-by-case basis
content.s5_1Text: It is your responsibility to ensure your device is eSIM-compatible and carrier-unlocked before purchasing.
content.s5_2Text: While we strive for reliable coverage, mobile data service is dependent on local network operators and may be affected by network congestion, maintenance, weather, or geographic factors.
content.s5_3Text: All plans are subject to fair usage policies. Plans are for personal use only and may not be resold or commercially exploited.
